data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Cross-KB Topic Connection & Mermaid Flow Graph — Integrating the 6 Context/Cache/Memory Publications with GEAP L200, L300, and L400 OKF
data.description: Cross-KB ontology, Mermaid architectural flow graphs, FDE diagnostic routing trees, and Cloud Spanner Property Graph (GQL) schemas uniting Concepts 36–44 (the 6 Context, Cache, Memory, and Socratic Grilling publications) with GEAP L200/L300 (Concepts 00–35) and L400 (A1–O6, 18–21).
